svg.aria-label: One Volta SM. An L1 instruction cache sits on top of four processing blocks. Each block has a warp scheduler and dispatch unit issuing 32 threads per clock, a 64 KB register file, 8 FP64, 16 INT32 and 16 FP32 units, 2 tensor cores, load/store units and an SFU. All four share a 128 KB L1 data cache and shared memory, with shared memory up to 96 KB. The tensor core computes D = A times B plus C on FP16 inputs, there is no BF16 or TF32, and V100 has 80 of these SMs.
svg.text: 128 KB L1 data cache + shared memory
shared by all 4 blocks, shared memory up to 96 KB
